purpose: Single-select input that filters a fixed option list as the user types, combining free-text search with constrained values.
useWhen: Choosing one value from a long list where typing is faster than scrolling.
Letting users narrow options by substring while still requiring a constrained selection.

avoidWhen.reason: Picking from a short fixed list with no need to filter — use select instead.
Querying remote data or accepting free-text submissions — use search-field instead.
